title: Milestone 4: implement VC4Tile and lower to SSAVC4
locked_goal: Define the VC4 Tile dialect (`vc4tile`) as the VC4-specific tile/kernel IR above SSAVC4, and implement incremental `vc4tile -> ssavc4` lowering so VC4Tile-authored fixtures lower through the existing `ssavc4 -> scheduled vc4 -> artifacts/runtime` lower half. M4 does not implement producer lowering from Triton, IREE, StableHLO, Torch-MLIR, JAX, PyTorch, or upstream MLIR `gpu`.

gate_environment_contract.lit_run_line_contract: Every %token in changed RUN lines must be defined by lit config or be a lit builtin.

slices.title: M4 milestone package
slices.intent: Install the M4 descriptor, worklist, verification spec, context profiles, prompt package, and design/plan documents. No compiler implementation source is allowed in this slice.
non_goals: Do not implement Triton, IREE, StableHLO, JAX, PyTorch, or MLIR `gpu` producer lowering in M4; those future producer adapters must target `vc4tile` after M4.

Do not special-case fixture names, public names, expected JSON, QASM, shader arrays, runtime logs, or `VC4_TEST_RESULT` text.
Do not use physical `QPU_NUMBER` for logical request, warp, lane, block, or program identity.

abi_refactor_pause.reason: M4 slices 4-8 exposed an ABI category bug: program_id was treated as a generic uniform/user argument instead of a runtime builtin identity op.
abi_refactor_pause.resume_condition: Do not resume m4-09 until ABI-8 hardware regression and cumulative check-vc4 pass.
stages: ABI-2 lower vc4 launch builtin enum/schema modernization
ABI-3 artifact emitter + SSAVC4 spill/runtime builtin modernization
ABI-6 VC4TileToSSAVC4 formal-arg and builtin lowering
ABI-7 M4 fixture rewrite plus program_id hardware proof
ABI-8 hardware regression and cumulative check-vc4

abi_categories.kernel_arguments: vc4tile.kernel formal arguments -> vc4.launch_abi.args[] -> generated launch wrapper parameters -> uniform stream transport
abi_categories.runtime_builtins: zero-operand vc4tile identity ops/lower-half metadata -> vc4.launch_abi.builtins[] -> vc4_launch_request_info uniform packing
abi_categories.lane_register_builtins: vc4tile.lane_id/vc4tile.lane_range/ssavc4.element_number -> hardware lane identity, not launch ABI and not uniforms
